detailed_results.question: Qual è l'importo totale incassato (total_amount) per tutte le corse?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10

detailed_results.question: Quante corse hanno registrato una mancia (tip_amount) maggiore di zero?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 WHERE tip_amount > 0

detailed_results.question: Qual è il costo medio dei pedaggi (tolls_amount) per corsa?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(tolls_amount) FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10

detailed_results.question: Mostrami la distanza media (trip_distance) e l'importo medio (total_amount) per ciascun tipo di pagamento (payment_type).
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_type, AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_distance, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_amount FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY payment_type

detailed_results.question: Qual è il numero totale di corse effettuate per ciascuna zona di partenza (PULocationID)? Ordina per numero di corse decrescente.
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS total_trips FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY PULocationID ORDER BY total_trips DESC

detailed_results.question: Qual è la mancia media (tip_amount) per ciascun tipo di tariffa (RatecodeID)?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT RatecodeID, AVG(tip_amount) AS avg_tip FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY RatecodeID

detailed_results.question: Mostrami le 10 zone di arrivo (DOLocationID) più frequenti con il relativo importo medio totale.
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT DOLocationID, COUNT(*) AS trip_count, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_amount FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY DOLocationID ORDER BY trip_count DESC LIMIT 10

detailed_results.question: Calcola la distanza media percorsa e l'importo medio per le corse con più di 4 passeggeri.
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_dist, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_tot FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 WHERE passenger_count > 4

detailed_results.question: Quante corse hanno un importo totale (total_amount) superiore a 100 euro o dollari?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 WHERE total_amount > 100

detailed_results.question: Mostrami la media della tariffa base (fare_amount) e dei pedaggi (tolls_amount) raggruppati per VendorID.
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT VendorID, AVG(fare_amount) AS avg_fare, AVG(tolls_amount) AS avg_tolls FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY VendorID

detailed_results.question: Qual è il totale degli incassi (total_amount) e la mancia media per le corse pagate in contanti (payment_type = 2)?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue, AVG(tip_amount) AS avg_tip FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 WHERE payment_type = 2

detailed_results.question: Qual è la percentuale media di mancia rispetto alla tariffa base per il payment_type 1 (carta di credito)?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(tip_amount / fare_amount) * 100 AS avg_tip_percentage FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 WHERE payment_type = 1 AND fare_amount > 0

detailed_results.question: Mostrami le 5 tratte da partenza a destinazione (PULocationID e DOLocationID) più popolari.
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT PULocationID, DOLocationID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID ORDER BY route_count DESC LIMIT 5

detailed_results.question: Qual è il costo medio totale per corse con distanza percorsa tra 5 e 10 miglia o chilometri?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 WHERE trip_distance BETWEEN 5 AND 10

detailed_results.question: Quante corse hanno registrato un supplemento per traffico/ora di punta (extra > 0)?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 WHERE extra > 0

detailed_results.question: Mostrami il totale dei pedaggi pagati (tolls_amount) per ciascun tipo di tariffa (RatecodeID).
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT RatecodeID, SUM(tolls_amount) AS total_tolls FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY RatecodeID

detailed_results.question: Quali sono le 5 ore del giorno (0-23) con il maggior numero di corse e qual è la loro distanza media?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS pickup_hour, COUNT(*) AS total_trips, AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_distance FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) ORDER BY total_trips DESC LIMIT 5

detailed_results.question: Calcola il totale del fatturato (total_amount) e la distanza media per ciascun giorno della settimana.
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT DAYOFWEEK(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS day_of_week, SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue, AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_distance FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY DAYOFWEEK(tpep_pickup_datetime) ORDER BY day_of_week

detailed_results.question: Mostrami le 3 zone di partenza (PULocationID) che generano il maggior fatturato totale per corse con pagamenti con carta di credito (payment_type = 1).
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT PULocationID, SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 WHERE payment_type = 1 GROUP BY PULocationID ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

detailed_results.question: Qual è la durata media in minuti delle corse nel dataset?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tpep_dropoff_datetime) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tpep_pickup_datetime)) / 60) AS avg_duration_minutes FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10

detailed_results.question: Classifica i tipi di pagamento attribuendo 'Carta' al codice 1, 'Contanti' al codice 2 e 'Altro' per il resto, e calcola il fatturato totale per ciascuna categoria.
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN payment_type = 1 THEN 'Carta' WHEN payment_type = 2 THEN 'Contanti' ELSE 'Altro' END AS metodo_pagamento, SUM(total_amount) AS fatturato_totale FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY CASE WHEN payment_type = 1 THEN 'Carta' WHEN payment_type = 2 THEN 'Contanti' ELSE 'Altro' END

detailed_results.question: Mostrami il fatturato totale e il numero di corse per ogni ora della notte (dalle 00:00 alle 05:59).
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS night_hour, COUNT(*) AS trips, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 WHERE HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) BETWEEN 0 AND 5 GROUP BY HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) ORDER BY night_hour

detailed_results.question: Qual è la velocità media in miglia o chilometri orari delle corse per ciascun VendorID?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT VendorID, AVG(trip_distance / ((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tpep_dropoff_datetime) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tpep_pickup_datetime)) / 3600)) AS avg_speed_mph FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 WHERE (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tpep_dropoff_datetime) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tpep_pickup_datetime)) > 0 GROUP BY VendorID

detailed_results.question: Quali zone di partenza (PULocationID) hanno un numero di corse superiore a 10.000 e una mancia media superiore a 3?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS trip_count, AVG(tip_amount) AS avg_tip FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY PULocationID HAVING COUNT(*) > 10000 AND AVG(tip_amount) > 3

detailed_results.question: Calcola la distribuzione delle corse per fascia oraria: 'Mattina' (6-11), 'Pomeriggio' (12-17), 'Sera' (18-23), 'Notte' (0-5).
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'Mattina' WHEN HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'Pomeriggio' WHEN HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) BETWEEN 18 AND 23 THEN 'Sera' ELSE 'Notte' END AS fascia_oraria, COUNT(*) AS num_corse FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY CASE WHEN HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN 'Mattina' WHEN HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN 'Pomeriggio' WHEN HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) BETWEEN 18 AND 23 THEN 'Sera' ELSE 'Notte' END

detailed_results.question: Quali sono le 5 coppie di partenza e arrivo (PULocationID, DOLocationID) con la durata media della corsa più lunga?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT PULocationID, DOLocationID, AVG((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tpep_dropoff_datetime) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(tpep_pickup_datetime)) / 60) AS avg_duration_min FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 ORDER BY avg_duration_min DESC LIMIT 5

detailed_results.question: Calcola la percentuale di corse che hanno pagato un pedaggio (tolls_amount > 0) rispetto al totale delle corse.
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN tolls_amount > 0 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS toll_trip_percentage FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10

detailed_results.question: Mostrami l'importo totale delle mance e della tariffa base suddivisi per tipo di tariffa (RatecodeID) per corse con più di 2 passeggeri.
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT RatecodeID, SUM(tip_amount) AS total_tips, SUM(fare_amount) AS total_fares FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 WHERE passenger_count > 2 GROUP BY RatecodeID

detailed_results.question: Qual è il valore massimo e la media della mancia (tip_amount) per le corse la cui distanza è superiore alla distanza media generale?
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT MAX(tip_amount) AS max_tip, AVG(tip_amount) AS avg_tip FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 WHERE trip_distance > (SELECT AVG(trip_distance) FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10)

detailed_results.question: Mostrami i 3 giorni del mese in cui si è registrato il maggior fatturato totale.
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT DAYOFMONTH(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS day_of_month, SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 GROUP BY DAYOFMONTH(tpep_pickup_datetime) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

detailed_results.question: Calcola l'incasso totale della tariffa aeroportuale (mTA_tax o congestion_surcharge) e della mancia per le corse appartenenti alla tariffa aeroporto (RatecodeID = 2 o 3).
detailed_results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT RatecodeID, SUM(tip_amount) AS total_tips, SUM(tolls_amount) AS total_tolls, SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM yellow_tripdata_2022_10 WHERE RatecodeID IN (2, 3) GROUP BY RatecodeID
